bayts.text: his Family and his Companions; and bestow grace without harm, O best Everlasting Bestower of grace.
Bless and grant peace, O Granter of goodness, upon him whom You named ʿAyn al-Ghurr (Choicest of the illustrious),
his Family and his Companions; and with goodness be bountiful to me without enmity or delusion.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon the Prophet of Allah, Saʿd Allāh (Felicity of Allah),
the Family and the Companions, without end, O You Who protected me from (transgressing) prohibitions.
O You to Whom belong the command as well as the creation (Qurʾān 7:54), bless the Chosen One, Saʿd al-Khalq (Felicity of creation),
and grant him peace with the Family and his Companions, in the present and then in what will be fulfilled.
O Everlasting Who has been for me without griefs, lead the blessing to the Orator of the nations,
and grant him peace together with the Family and his Companions, O You Who heard my supplication.
Bless with peace the Glory of the Arabs, the Raiser of ranks, the Dispeller of distress,
his Family and his Companions; and praise this composition with the praise of the Enricher, the Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
Bless with peace the Lord of relief, the full moon, of noble issue,
his Family with the perfect Companions; and raise my work for Your noble Face.
O our Lord, bless and grant peace for ever upon the Prophet of distinctions, Aḥmad,
O our Lord, bless and grant peace for ever upon the Messenger, and make my joy everlasting.
O our Lord, bless and grant peace at all times upon Your Prophet, imām of the righteous.
O our Lord, bless and grant peace eternally upon Your intimate friend, lamp of whoever worships,
O our Lord, bless and grant peace for ever upon him whom You named Muḥammad,
upon his Family and his Companions; and forgive whoever reads this composition at any time,
and grant him all that You choose for him with You: truly You are the One Who chooses.
And let fall the sins that weigh upon him, O You Who by his rank have filled my bucket.
And grant to whoever reads it or writes it the best of wishes, O You Whose Books have reached me.
And grant to whoever memorises it or acquires it in any way, by the Prophet, his hope.
O our Lord, direct a blessing with peace to him to whom You granted the most excellent of speech.
O our Lord, convey my age-old greeting to him whose best servant I have become.
O our Lord, make Your two greetings everlasting for him by whose rank You granted me the best security.
O our Lord, extend Your two greetings without end to him who accepted my blessing.
O our Lord, give Your intimate friend, the beloved, glad tidings of my service, and (gladden) every righteous, discerning one.
Āmīn, O Lord, by the right of Your Face, O One, Whose like cannot be sought.
O You for Whose noble Face I wrote this composition, lead to me (Your) immense favours,
without harm, nor lovesickness, nor peril, nor enemies, nor trial, nor misfortune.
O You for Whose noble Face I wrote this book, grant me protection from reproach
in all things, outward and inward, and benefit by it, O my Master, the lands.
And make it a benefit for the people of the cities and others, O Giver of helpers.
O Lord of the earths and the sky, bless without number him who accepted my service,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him peace, and forgive, O Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), those who read it, and through it soften the averse.
And make the letters of this composition, for ever, a great glad tiding for Aḥmad.
And bless him and grant him peace, with his Family and whoever traces himself to him.
And through it repel the Accursed, before he heads (toward him), toward others than its reciter: You are the Helper.
And draw to whoever reads it the best object of desire, and lead him, O Lord of creatures, through the best of pastures.
And grant whoever reads it that for which others will (holily) envy him, O Beautiful One Who invigorates him.
O Lord of the lands and the servants, bless and grant peace upon the Prophet, and be for me
with his Family and his Companions; and raise my striving toward You, that it may rise with good pleasure.
O our Lord, bless and grant peace for ever upon a noble one who has been praised entirely,
our master Muḥammad, the seal of those You sent as prophets, O Lord of time,
upon his Family and his Companions; and make this composition a wonder, accomplished through him.
O You Who commanded all the believers to invoke blessings upon the Chosen One among the messengers (Qurʾān 33:56),
accept from me a blessing I have uttered in verse for Your Face, O You Who erased my sloth.
Accept then, out of generosity, my composition and all my striving, and do not reject what, among deeds, is for me as a refuge.
Accept it from me by grace, not by reckoning, and lead my hope to me without toil through it.
Accept with thanks by Your grace my striving and be pleased with it, O You through Whom I became rightly guided and did not swerve.
You are the Generous One Whose generosity I seek, O best Guide, Who guided me along the most excellent paths.
Be for me, by the rank of the Messenger of Allah, O our Master: upon him the best blessing from You, on my behalf.
And raise this composition of mine by generosity and honour, and do not reject it, O Remover of ailments.
Join the composition tomorrow to the striving of the Companions, and do not reject it, O Remover of defects.
Besides You I have hoped in none, in secret or in the open: by the right of Your Face, fulfil my hope, bestow!
O Lord, be for me and lead my aim to me with good pleasure, and what I have sought by the rank of the Select One, bestow it!
Bless and grant peace upon the Chosen One among the noble, and give glad tidings through my composition to the most excellent of messengers.
